notes.title: Alien Prop Hunt Officially Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41517109/5c63f6ce8c203ebb0d39b4b4ddf641323f1bfeda.png[/img]


[h1][b]Alien Prop Hunt is now live![/b][/h1]
Jump into an exciting new take on a classic concept! Alien Prop Hunt is an action packed team-based game where one team desperately tries to hide in plain sight, while the other relentlessly searches through environments to find them! Grab your copy now to claim a special launch event discount!

Features:

[list]
[*] Online multiplayer!
[*] Four exciting levels to explore and hide in!
[*] Two unique game modes!
[*] Hundreds of potential props to become!
[*] Tutorial levels to help you learn the basics!
[*] 100% unique custom made assets, not found in any other game!
[/list]

Feel free to leave feedback in the community up, or contact us at info@squiggly.games! We'd love to hear what you think!

notes.title: Alien Prop Hunt Beta Live Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41517109/bd7e5500ad5ab5658d81d84fc981219adace7ae7.png[/img]

[h1]The Alien Prop Hunt playtest is live NOW! [/h1]

Download the playtest for free, and go hunt some aliens! The beta includes these features:

3 Brand new levels - [i]Airport, New York Streets, and Movie Prop Studio[/i]

4 Prop abilities - [i]Invisibility, Speed, EMP Blast, and Decoy![/i]



[h1]We need your help![/h1]

The beta is our first big step towards releasing this game! Your feedback is critical to making sure the game development heads in the right direction so that Alien Prop Hunt becomes the most fun version of itself that it can be! Here's what we're looking for:

[list]
[*]Bug reports - What's not working?
[*]Feature Suggestions - Is something missing? What would make your experience better?
[*]Level Ideas - We're going to add more levels! Do you have ideas for locations? Do you prefer big, medium, or small levels?
[*]New Abilities - Do you have ideas for new powers that we should add? Let us know!
[*]Share the game! - Tell you friends to try it out! It's free, why not? The more people that play, the better the game will be!
[/list]


See you in-game!
-Squiggly Games
